name: Riplox Desktop 1.5.0 - the download decision layer
notes: The factors are the eleven derived in the 2026-08-15 sweep, plus 'format',
which is where all three of today's bugs lived and which nothing had modelled.
Coverage is over THESE factors. Anything not listed here is at 0%, however

gates.why: a 1080p+ merge needs the encoder, so the app degrades the format selector before it gets here - format_args drops every ffmpeg flag and the UI shows Limited mode
gates.tested_at: format_args and the Limited-mode banner, not the download below them

gates.why: pausing is per site and only the four named sites have a sign-in to pause

repros.name: r01-network-drop-permanent-fail
repros.why: 1 Sep 2026: net dropped mid-download, job landed in Failed for ever and the error text was empty

repros.name: r02-second-door-overwrites-wait
repros.why: 1 Sep 2026: _run_engine returned False for a requeued job and the second door failed it anyway

repros.name: r03-skipped-fragments-called-done
repros.why: 1 Sep 2026: 36s of video against 390s of audio, marked done, twenty orphan .part-Frag files

repros.name: r04-bar-pinned-at-92
repros.why: 1 Sep 2026: the engine's first progress line reads 1024 of 1024, and max() held the bar there

repros.name: r05-size-jumps-up-and-down
repros.why: 1 Sep 2026: total_bytes_estimate falls as often as it rises - 346176 then 160272

repros.name: r06-proxy-hostname-unresolvable
repros.why: 1 Sep 2026 (found while fixing r01): a bad proxy reads exactly like a lost network

repros.name: r07-orphan-ytdlp-processes
repros.why: 25 Aug 2026: tie_to_app existed and was never called - four orphans, 13.8 hours of CPU

repros.name: r08-cp1252-paths
repros.why: 25 Aug 2026: yt-dlp writes cp1252, Riplox read utf-8, 56 of 244 library paths wrong

repros.name: r09-silent-stall-no-watchdog
repros.why: 25 Aug 2026: a job that could never extract span five hours showing 'downloading'

repros.name: r10-stale-media-url
repros.why: an 8K download outlived the URL YouTube issued for it; needs time, not another client

repros.name: r11-expired-session-kills-public
repros.why: a rejected sign-in took public reels down with it until the signed-out retry was added

repros.name: r12-terms-version-behind
repros.why: 29 Aug 2026: TERMS.txt said 1.4.1 on a 1.5.0 build - the document the installer shows

repros.name: r13-resume-part-wrong-file
repros.why: TikTok signs a fresh address each time; appending a second encode to half of the first

repros.name: r14-second-instance-hands-off
repros.why: a second copy must hand its link to the running one, not open a second window - hit for real during today's boot test

repros.name: r15-portable-data-beside-exe
repros.why: portable mode must keep Data/ beside the exe and never write to LOCALAPPDATA

repros.name: r16-cookies-db-locked
repros.why: Chrome-family cookie stores cannot be read while the browser is open; the message must send the user to the browser sign-in instead

sequences.name: s01-drop-then-return
steps: let the engine spend its retries
the job must resume, not fail, and not ship a partial file

sequences.name: s02-pause-resume-restart
steps: the job comes back and continues from its .part

sequences.name: s03-signed-in-refused-then-out
steps: the first refusal is the message kept

sequences.name: s04-engine-fails-then-door
steps: yt-dlp fails on a real refusal
